name: OpenVibe.VIP
notes: Memberships (ADR-012): plans, immutable versioned plan terms, perks, product bindings, member preferences and gated-resource policy. OpenVibe.Billing holds subscriptions, charges, renewals, refunds and the canonical entitlements; VIP keeps a short-lived projection of them (valid_until, authoritative fallback, 'unknown' never authorizes). Alpha: not deployed; openvibe.vip stays on its OpenVibe.Sites placeholder until the launch rule holds.
